newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste sees $29 mln in savings from deal.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste sees $29 mln in savings from deal.

text.p: USA Waste Inc said Monday it expects to reap $29 million in savings and synergies in the first year of its proposed $1.7 billion merger with United Waste Systems Inc.
USA Waste also said the proposed transaction will add at least $0.05 per share to its earnings.

Lew Nevins, vice president of investor relations, also said USA Waste will pursue other acquisitions. The company has targeted some $400 million in acquisitions for the year, not including United Waste, he said.
Of the $29 million of savings, some $15 million will come from operational efficiencies such as route consolidations, said Nevins, vice president of investor relations.
Another $11 million is expected from corporate and overhead expenses, while $3 million is pegged to other administrative areas, he said.
Shares of both companies dropped sharply after they announced the stock-swap merger early today.

"What we need to do is get out there and talk to people about the transaction and why we're so pleased with it and why it will be accretive and the plans we have to make it a very good deal for both shareholder groups," Nevins said.
"Apparently it's not as well understood as we think it should be."
